preconditions.description: The length of the word s is between 1 and 100.
The word s consists of uppercase and lowercase Latin letters only.

postconditions.description: The length of the corrected word is the same as the length of the input word.

postconditions.expression: all(c.islower() if corrected_s.islower() else all(c.isupper() for c in corrected_s), for c in s)
postconditions.description: All letters in the corrected word are either all lowercase or all uppercase, depending on which case is more frequent in the input word. If the counts are equal, all letters are converted to lowercase.
